title: add-benchmark-lab-profiling-baselines-and-reporting-pipeline-v94
author: Alex Chen
description: This PR introduces profiling baselines and an updated reporting pipeline (v94) for the benchmark-lab. Motivation: we've been iterating on profiling baselines and representative runners for multi-tenant GPU/CPU workloads; teams need a reproducible nightly baseline and a reporting pipeline to publish baseline metrics to the analytics workspace. Scope: - Add formal baseline artifacts (cold/warm start profiles for common GPU types) and runner glue code for representative workloads (chat, completion, embeddings). - New reporting pipeline v94 (Airflow DAG + exporters) that aggregates profiling runs and pushes summarized metrics to BigQuery + Looker dashboards. - Nightly CI job to run a lightweight profiling sweep in the benchmark-lab infra image. - Small infra changes: bump benchmark docker image, add sampling and labeling metadata for better aggregation, and fix flaky runner tests. Checklist: - [x] Add profiling baseline JSON artifacts and README - [x] Add representative workload runners for chat/completions/embeddings - [x] Implement reporting DAG and exporter - [x] Add nightly profiling CI job and document config toggles - [x] Update docs with baseline interpretation guidance Backwards compatibility: all runners are opt-in via config flags (BENCHMARK_ENABLE) and the pipeline defaults to v93 until the reporting team flips the release flag. No breaking changes to existing APIs. Testing: unit tests for runner plumbing and CI to run a minimal profiling sweep; integration tests validate pipeline export on a mocked BigQuery. Rollout: merged to main and will be enabled for nightly runs after infra operator flips feature flag. Notes: some long-running profiling artifacts are stored in GCS under gs://redwood-benchmark/artifacts/v94, and dashboards updated to reference v94 aggregates.
